Section A, new, from the Night rain recipe. Rain, with orbits on the downbeat. The wire skull is the centrepiece. The cosmos: the camera flies with the track, drawn in by builds and let go on drops, each section on the galaxy arm that suits it. The glow flies behind the planets. A 5-way kaleidoscope folds inside the centrepiece, turning. Orbits slower and bigger than usual. Lightning cracks on the stabs. Changes fade in. Colours: one hue against two. Pace: steady, pulsing every other beat.
